note_en: 一边……一边…… means doing two things at once: 一边系安全带，一边检查救援设备 "buckling our seat belts while checking the rescue equipment." English makes one action the main verb and tucks the other into a "while" or "-ing" phrase, but Chinese puts 一边 before each verb and treats both as equals. The subject is named only once, before the first 一边.
